subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should maintainers require a live Telegram forum-topic reproduction before promoting a fix, or is a focused source harness around topic routing, spool claims, and stuck-session recovery enough?
rationale: The report and corroboration are strong, but current source only proves adjacent guarded-lane mechanics; the restart-surviving per-topic drop state remains unidentified.

options.title: Require live Telegram reproduction
options.body: Keep this in maintainer/live investigation until a real topic can reproduce the post-restart black-hole and identify the durable state owner.

options.title: Allow focused source harness
options.body: Let an engineer build a narrow harness around Telegram topic routing, spool claims, and stuck-session recovery before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Defer to the lane PR
options.body: Treat the in-process guarded-lane PR as sufficient despite the remaining restart-persistent evidence gap.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram reproduction
recommendation.body: Keep this in maintainer/live investigation until a real topic can reproduce the post-restart black-hole and identify the durable state owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The related PR review already frames the safe cancellation or restart-boundary decision for this code path.
